note: Measures FORWARD composition only: enc_fwd binds a content through the chain in order, enc_rev through the same relations reversed, enc_perm through a random permutation. No unbinding, so this isolates the order question from Axiom 3 exactly as ChainOrder.lean does. cos = 1.0 means blind to the reordering. edubind2 is the two-element family the KERNEL-TIER instance edubindVSA is built from; d4 is all eight elements of the same group (d4Gen); edubind is the CONTINUOUS O(2) family the implementation samples, which no kernel-tier theorem covers.
